ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.69" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" ray start --head --node-ip-address 10.1.1.69 --port 6379 --num-gpus 1 --disable-usage-stats

ssh -o BatchMode=yes node1 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.68" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" ray start --address 10.1.1.69:6379 --node-ip-address 10.1.1.68 --num-gpus 1 --disable-usage-stats
LAB_EOF
# [cluster] verify ray sees 2 GPUs
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.69" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" python -c 'import ray; ray.init(address='"'"'auto'"'"'); n = int(ray.cluster_resources().get('"'"'GPU'"'"', 0)); print(f'"'"'ray_gpus={n}'"'"'); raise SystemExit(0 if n >= 2 else 1)'
LAB_EOF
# [launch] start static-batch benchmark
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
cd "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2" || exit 1
nohup env PATH="$HOME/inference-sim-lab/.venv/bin:$PATH" HF_HOME="$HOME/.cache/huggingface" NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME="bond0" VLLM_HOST_IP="10.1.1.69" PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1" python "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/bench/bench_latency.py" --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct --shapes 1x512,1x2048,8x512,8x2048,32x512 --decode 128 --warmup 2 --iters 5 --tp 1 --pp 2 --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 4096 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-num-seqs 64 --seed 0 --output "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/results.jsonl" --backend ray > "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/bench.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
LAB_EOF
# [wait] static-batch results (poll until complete=1, expected=5, timeout=3600s)
ssh -o BatchMode=yes node0 bash -l -s <<'LAB_EOF'
n=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.static_batch.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); d=$(grep -c '^{.*"record": "lab.done.v1"' "$HOME/inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/results.jsonl" 2>/dev/null); if pgrep -f '[b]ench_latency.py.*2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2' >/dev/null; then a=1; else a=0; fi; if [ "${d:-0}" -ge 1 ] && [ "${n:-0}" -ge 5 ]; then c=1; else c=0; fi; echo "complete=$c progress=${n:-0} alive=$a"
LAB_EOF
# [collect] collect results.jsonl
scp -q node0:inference-sim-lab/runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/results.jsonl /runs/2026-09-28-qwen7b-static-pp2/measured.jsonl
